stem: Which medicine is expected to last about 10–12 hours?
explanation: Lisdexamphetamine (Vyvanse) is the stimulant option expected to last about 10–12 hours.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because lisdexamphetamine (Vyvanse) is listed as lasting about 10–12 hours.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because Ritalin LA is shorter, at about 7–8 hours.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because Concerta is listed as lasting about 12 hours rather than the 10–12 hour range given for lisdexamphetamine.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because clonidine is not the stimulant option described by this duration.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because atomoxetine is a non-stimulant medicine, not the 10–12 hour stimulant formulation.
